Santa Leticia: Underground Pirate Radio From Spain (WOH 2026)

SAT 22.08.26

Santa Leticia explores music, poetry and underground broadcasting in Spain during and after Franco’s dictatorship, looking at how artists, musicians and informal radio and listening networks kept cultural memory and resistance alive under censorship. Live from WOH Radio stage through storytelling, Federico García Lorca's poetry, protest folk, flamenco and regional songwriting, the show reflects on sound as a form of survival, identity and collective memory.
